name: Tilapia and bream
desc: Cichlid fish that feed on plants and algae. They are a main food of the African fish eagle.
about: Tilapia ( tih-LAH-pee-ə) is the common name for nearly a hundred species of cichlid fish from the coelotilapine, coptodonine, heterotilapine, oreochromine, pelmatolapiine, and tilapiine tribes…
